column1: # The record's own drawdown-EPISODE statistics, on `uni.apps.MarketSim.episodes`' definition:
# every peak-to-trough decline of at least `threshold` percent in a daily series, with the running
# peak seeded at the window's first session. `EpisodeAnchorSuite` / `episode_anchor_tests` re-derive
# `medDepth` from the thr=15 row of the window each anchor set names. Editing a row moves the
# shipped target.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. `medDepth` shipped as -27.1% through 0.21.0 with no recorded convention, and
# the model measures 15%+ episodes. No window of the record produces -27.1% at that threshold; a 20%
# threshold does (-26.6% over 1954-2026, -28.0% over the century). The model was therefore graded
# against a statistic it does not compute, and pushed toward crashes deeper than the record's for its
# own definition. The two sibling anchors reconcile: `crashes/century` 20.7 sits between the 19.2 and
# 24.9 measured here, and `worst crash %` -56.8 is the same 2007-09 episode as the -54.6% below.
# Source: Ken French's F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily, CRSP value-weighted US market TOTAL return
# (Mkt-RF + RF) compounded to a level series -- the same control the `return per vol` and
# `clustering` anchors use. Measured 2026-08-29, data through 2026-06.
# thr        the decline threshold in percent, the model's own is 15
# n          episodes in the window        perCentury  n scaled to 100 years
# median     median episode depth, percent (negative)  worst  the deepest
